propositions: The completion verifier's schema-blind JSON extraction selects the first parseable object rather than the first schema-valid object, returning a Dep record instead of CompletionVerdict when the verifier's prose quotes dependency records from show_ticket results before the verdict.

When a parent ticket has children with depends_on links, the verifier calls show_ticket, quotes the Dep JSON in prose before the verdict, and tolerant_parse incorrectly selects that quoted record as structured output, causing validation failure and fail-closed refusal to close.

The selection defect spans five historical recurrences across all structured LLM gates (completion verifier, plan-review, code-review) because tolerant_parse prioritizes fence-wrapped blocks and first-parseable-objects without consulting the target schema.

Schema-blind selection cannot be fixed by loosening CompletionVerdict to accept Dep records; the fail-closed refusal is correct and the returned shape is the defect, requiring either schema-aware selection in the prompted path or adoption of provider-native structured output where available.

The fix architecture spans four layers: provider-native NativeOutput on Bedrock sonnet-4-6/haiku-4-5 (E1 proven viable for no-tools steps, stays prompted for agentic tools due to thinking x tools interaction), sentinel channel directive with last-block-wins, schema-filtered candidate selection in parse_structured with key-overlap screening, and property-test corpus to encode the invariant that any prose plus rendered payload recovers the payload.

The completion verifier's b586 ticket closes only when a reply layout happens to place the verdict before prose that quotes deps; repeatable failure on other layouts proves the trigger is layout-dependent, not model drift or context corruption.
